programs.name: MS in Information Technology
programs.overview: WPI's MS in Information Technology is a 33-credit graduate degree grounded in a technology-focused university that prepares students for IT leadership roles.

prerequisites.programming_courses: At least one prior college-level programming course
prerequisites.math_requirement: Three semesters of college-level math OR two semesters of calculus (grade B or better)
prerequisites.notes: All prerequisites must be met before enrollment

core_courses.name: Policy and Strategy for IT and Analytics
core_courses.description: Covers policy and strategic planning in IT and analytics

core_courses.name: Business Intelligence
core_courses.description: Explores business intelligence systems and practices

core_courses.name: Data Management for Analytics
core_courses.description: Focuses on data management principles for analytics applications

specializations.name: Artificial Intelligence in Business
specializations.description: Focus on AI applications in business contexts

courses.name: Business Applications in Machine Learning
courses.description: Machine learning techniques for business applications

courses.name: AI and Ethics OR Policy and Strategy

options.name: Artificial Intelligence and its Ethical Applications in Business
Policy and Strategy for Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, and Analytics

courses.description: Choose between AI ethics or IT policy and strategy

courses.name: Marketing or Process Optimization Elective
courses.description: Choose one elective from marketing research, analytics, or process optimization

specializations.name: Information Systems Design
specializations.description: Focus on designing and securing information systems

specializations.name: Data Analytics
specializations.description: Focus on data analytics and machine learning

courses.name: Digital Marketing OR Marketing Research
courses.description: Choose between digital marketing or marketing research

specializations.name: Digital Transformation
specializations.description: Focus on innovation and organizational transformation

options.name: Designing and Managing Lean Six Sigma Processes

courses.name: Project Management or Leadership Elective
courses.description: Choose one project management or leadership course

specializations.name: IT User Experience
specializations.description: Focus on user experience design and research

capstone.description: REQUIRED: You must complete 2 capstone courses for a total of 6 credits. Both courses are mandatory and cannot be waived.

courses.name: System Design and Development
courses.description: Complete system design and development capstone project

program_structure.notes: Students must complete: 3 core courses (9 credits) + 2 three-course specializations (18 credits) + 2 capstone courses (6 credits) = 33 total credits. You MUST choose TWO different specializations from the five available.

important_notes.specialization_requirement: You must complete TWO different three-course specializations (not just one)
important_notes.internship_option: International students on-campus are encouraged to complete up to three additional internship credits
important_notes.course_selection: Many specialization courses have options - you choose one course from the listed alternatives
important_notes.capstone_timing: Capstone courses are typically taken near the end of the program
